memory_verse.label: Bible Portion
memory_verse.text: "There above it stood the LORD, and he said: 'I am the LORD, the God of your father Abraham and the God of Isaac. I will give you and your descendants the land on which you are lying. Your descendants will be like the dust of the earth, and you will spread out to the west and to the east, to the north and to the south. All peoples on earth will be blessed through you and your offspring. I am with you and will watch over you wherever you go, and I will bring you back to this land. I will not leave you until I have done what I have promised you'" - Gen 28:13-15 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
God stands above the stairway and speaks to Jacob — and every word is grace. Notice what God does not say. He does not scold Jacob for deceiving his father. He does not list conditions Jacob must meet first. Instead, He simply gives: "I am with you and will watch over you wherever you go... I will not leave you until I have done what I have promised."

This is astonishing. Jacob is a fugitive, running from the mess he has made. And God meets him not with a rebuke but with promises — presence, protection, and an unbreakable commitment. God takes the initiative, offering His faithfulness to a man who has done nothing to earn it. That is the very heart of grace.

The promise "all peoples on earth will be blessed through you and your offspring" pointed forward to Christ, through whom blessing has come to the whole world (Gal 3:8). And the promise "I am with you... I will not leave you" echoes down to us in Jesus, who assures His people, "I am with you always" (Matt 28:20), and, "Never will I leave you" (Heb 13:5).

Wherever you are running today, hear God's word to Jacob. He meets us in grace, promises His presence, and will not abandon what He has begun in us.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
Does it surprise you that God met Jacob with grace, not rebuke?
Where do you need to hear God's promise, "I am with you"?
Do you trust that God will not leave His work in you unfinished?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Faithful God, thank You that You meet me with grace even when I am running from my own mistakes. Thank You for Your promise to be with me and never leave me. Amen.
